title: Mediterranean auction war is not worth it
description: Mediterranean auction war is not worth it. Brown completion is cheap, but not worth a war while Alpha faces built light blue. The hard part is resisting bid_auction when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: Need Mediterranean to complete Brown monopoly with Baltic. Current high bid 118, min next 119. I have 235 cash, can afford and still have reserve. Bidding 119 secures property cheaply; if outbid, can consider higher later but for now stay in.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses drop_out for this auction state.
Did not satisfy: Dropping preserves the unsafe post-bid cash reserve.
Did not satisfy: Declines the bluff when the cash leader can punish it.
